title: Canonical coefficient comparisons for supported products and Thom maps
statement: Use the supported-product ordinary presentations and scalar-unit map [def-pur-finite-product-scalar-presentation], the actual compact-support and root coefficient arrows [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows], and the closed/single comparisons [cor-pur-affine-space-zero-section-purity]. For $a\le b$, the affine zero section $z:S\to\mathbf A^r_S$ over a separated finite-type base, define the supported source comparison $Q(z_*A)\to z_*B$ by the inverse closed/single comparison, the specified compact-support coefficient mate, the direct image of the coefficient-unit map, and the forward closed/single comparison. More generally this formula defines the closed-source comparison for exact closed direct images and a specified source coefficient arrow. Define $Q(T_{r,A})\to T_{r,B}$ by the two ordered ordinary presentations and the site/scalar realization of the tensor power of a CoefficientLineComparison. That record fixes the root power map, every scalar/root generator, and the derived scalar counit; an arbitrary endpoint isomorphism is never substituted.
